examples.text: tañ'ca acchena vārinā, pasannamānaso naro, nhāpayī rukkhamūlasmiṃ, chāyāya ekacīvaraṃ.
pītapāsādasayane, pīt'āsane pītabhājane, pītachatte pītarathe, pīt'asse pītabījane.

89002.meaning1: having given delight; having pleased; having made one happy

examples.text: pañc'ettha nāriyo āgamaṃsu nhāyituṃ, sīt'odakaṃ uppaliniṃ sivaṃ nadiṃ, tā tattha nhāyitvā rametvā devatā, naccitvā gāyitvā sutā lataṃ bravi.

89003.commentary: (VVa) rucak'upatiṇṇan'ti suvaṇṇavālikāhi okiṇṇ'aṅgaṇaṃ. vālikasadisā hi suvaṇṇakhaṇḍā rucā nāma, rucam'eva rucakan'ti vuttaṃ. (VVa) rucak'atthatā'ti tassaṃ tassaṃ bhūmiyaṃ suvaṇṇaphalakehi atthatā.

examples.text: phalikarajatahemajālachannaṃ, vividhacitratalam'addasaṃ surammaṃ, byamhaṃ sunimmitaṃ toraṇ'ūpapannaṃ, rucak'upakiṇṇam'idaṃ subhaṃ vimānaṃ.

89004.commentary: (VVa) vāḷī'ti vāḷavanto sampannavāḷadhino, asse sandhāya vadati. vājī'ti vā pāṭho.

examples.text: ime ca vāḷī maṇicandakappitā, ārohakambū sujavā brah'ūpamā, brahā mahantā balino mahājavā, mano tav'aññāya tath'eva siṃsare.
ime ca vāḷī maṇicandakappitā, ārohakambū sujavā brah'ūpamā, brahā mahantā balino mahājavā, mano tav'aññāya tath'eva siṃsare.
satthiṃ ākoṭayitvāna, vaha sammā'ti c'abravi, ahaṃ lokaṃ tārayissaṃ, patto sambodhim'uttamaṃ.

89007.commentary: (PVa) etaṃ acchādayitvāna, mama dakkhiṇamādisā'ti etaṃ upāsakaṃ mama diyyamānaṃ sāṭakaṃ paridahāpetvā taṃ dakkhiṇaṃ mayhaṃ ādisa pattidānaṃ dehi.

examples.text: pariyosite vihāre, kārente niṭṭhite mahe, ambeh'acchādayitvāna, katvā dussamaye phale.
etaṃ acchādayitvāna, mama dakkhiṇam'ādisa, tath'āhaṃ sukhitā hessaṃ, sabbakāmasamiddhinī'ti.

89008.synonym: abbhudīresi, abhāsayi, abhāsi, avacāsi, bhaṇi, bhāsayi, bhāsi

examples.text: tam'enaṃ bāvarī disvā, āsanena nimantayi, sukhañ'ca kusalaṃ pucchi, idaṃ vacanam'abruvi.

89010.synonym: abbhudīresi, abhāsayi, abhāsi, avacāsi, bhaṇi, bhāsayi, bhāsi

examples.text: idaṃ sutvā tidasādhipati, maghavā devakuñjaro, tāvatiṃse pasādento, mātaliṃ etadabrūvī'ti.

89011.meaning1: belonging to a world; living in a realm
89011.commentary: (PVa) yamalokikā'ti yamaloko'ti laddhanāme petaloke tattha pariyāpannabhāvena viditā.

examples.text: ahaṃ bhadante petī'mhi, duggatā yamalokikā, pāpakammaṃ karitvāna, petalokaṃ ito gatā.

89012.meaning1: living in the world of the dead; in the ghost realm
89012.commentary: (PVa) yamalokikā'ti yamaloko'ti laddhanāme petaloke tattha pariyāpannabhāvena viditā.

examples.text: ahaṃ bhadante petī'mhi, duggatā yamalokikā, pāpakammaṃ karitvāna, petalokaṃ ito gatā.

89013.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of mukha

examples.text: taṃ ty'āhaṃ nārada brūmi, sāmaṃ diṭṭham'idaṃ tayā, m'ākāsi mukhasā pāpaṃ, mā kho sūkaramukho ahū'ti.

89014.meaning1: stake; spike; spear; pike; sharp pointy thing
89014.commentary: (PVa) ayam'eva sūlo nirayena tenā'ti tato imassa uppattiṭṭhānabhūtato nirayato ayam'eva sūlo seyyo'ti. nissakke hi idaṃ karaṇavacanaṃ. (JAa) na sūlo'ti ayaṃ sūlo'pi sādhutacchito maṃ na tapati, na me sokaṃ uppādeti.

examples.text: anekabhāgena guṇena seyyo, ayam'eva sūlo nirayena tena, ek'antadukkhaṃ kaṭukaṃ bhayānakaṃ, ek'antatibbaṃ nirayaṃ patāyaṃ.
na māyam'aggi tapati, na sūlo sādhutacchito, yañ'ca maṃ maññate macchī, aññaṃ so ratiyā gato.
na mantā mūlabhesajjā, osadhehi dhanena vā, sakkā ānayituṃ kaṇha, yaṃ petam'anusocasi.

89016.commentary: (PVa) sapathaṃ musāvādaṃ abhāsisan'ti sace taṃ mayā kataṃ, īdisī bhaveyyan'ti katam'eva pāpaṃ akataṃ katvā dassentī musāvādaṃ abhūtaṃ sapathaṃ abhāsiṃ.

examples.text: s'āhaṃ ghorañ'ca sapathaṃ, musāvādaṃ abhāsisaṃ, puttamaṃsāni khādāmi, sace taṃ pakataṃ mayā.

89017.grammar: adj, comp, from na paṭiganda, neg
89017.meaning1: free from foul odours; sweet smelling; fragrant
89017.construction:
na > a + pati + gandha + iya
appaṭigandha + iya
89017.commentary: (PVa) appaṭigandhiyā'ti paṭikūlagandharahitā surabhigandhā. (JAa) appaṭigandhiyan'ti paṭikūlagandhavirahitaṃ madhur'odaka-parikiṇṇaṃ nānappakārapadum'uppal'ādīhi sañchannaṃ.

examples.text: set'odakā suppatitthā, sītā appaṭigandhiyā, padum'uppala-sañchannā, vārikiñjakkhapūritā.
puthulomamacch'ākiṇṇaṃ, supatitthaṃ mah'odakaṃ, samañ'ca caturaṃsañ'ca, sāduṃ appaṭigandhiyaṃ.

89018.meaning1: having ended; having exhausted; (comm) having spent

examples.text: cullāsīti mahākappino, satasahassāni hi, ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā, saṃsāraṃ khepayitvāna, dukkhass'antaṃ karissare.
sahāyānaṃ titthasmiṃ nhāyantānaṃ, thale gahetvā nidahissa dussaṃ, khiḍḍ'atthiko no ca paduṭṭhacitto, ten'amhi naggo kasirā ca vuttī'ti.

89020.meaning1: (comm) wearing a turban; with head wrapped

examples.text: mālī kiriṭī kāyūrī, gattā te candan'ussadā, pasannamukhavaṇṇo'si, sūriyavaṇṇo'va sobhasi.
mālī kiriṭī kāyūrī, aṅgadī candan'ussado, rattiṃ tvaṃ paricāresi, divā vedesi vedanaṃ.
idaṃ vimānaṃ virajaṃ same ṭhitaṃ, uyyānavantaṃ ratinandivaḍḍhanaṃ, icchām'ahaṃ nāri anomadassane, tayā saha nandane idha moditun'ti.
sunakhā'p'imassa palihiṃsu pāde, dhaṅkā siṅgālā parivattayanti, gabbhāsayaṃ pakkhigaṇā haranti, kākā pana akkhimalaṃ haranti.

89023.meaning1: hurt by needles; (comm) afflicted with hunger
89023.commentary: (PVa) sūcik'aṭṭā'ti pūtinā lūkhagattā aṭṭakā, sūcikā'ti laddhanāmāya khuppipāsāya aṭṭā pīḷitā. sūcikaṇṭhā'ti keci paṭhan'ti, sūcichidda-sadisa-mukhadvārā'ti attho.

examples.text: te duggatā sūcik'aṭṭā, kilantā naggino kisā, uttasantā mahattāsā, na dassenti kurūrino.

89024.commentary: (PVa) sūcik'aṭṭā'ti pūtinā lūkhagattā aṭṭakā, sūcikā'ti laddhanāmāya khuppipāsāya aṭṭā pīḷitā. sūcikaṇṭhā'ti keci paṭhan'ti, sūcichidda-sadisa-mukhadvārā'ti attho.

examples.text: te duggatā sūcik'aṭṭā, kilantā naggino kisā, uttasantā mahattāsā, na dassenti kurūrino.

89025.synonym: khobheti, ghaṭṭeti, cāleti, pavedheti, byāthayati, loḷeti, saṅkhobheti
89025.commentary: (PVa) pubbe katānaṃ kammānaṃ, vipāko mathaye manan'ti purimāsu jātīsu katānaṃ akusalakammānaṃ phalaṃ uḷāraṃ hutvā uppajjamānaṃ andhabālānaṃ cittaṃ mathayeyya abhibhaveyya, paresaṃ anatthakaraṇamukhena attano atthaṃ uppādeyyā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: pubbe katānaṃ kammānaṃ, vipāko mathaye manaṃ, rūpe sadde rase gandhe, phoṭṭhabbe ca manorame.

89026.commentary: (JAa) kiṃ heṭṭhā kiñ'ca upparī'ti vuḍḍhitabhattena nāma upari sītalena, heṭṭhā uṇhena bhavitabbaṃ, idañ'ca pana na tādisaṃ, tena taṃ pucchāmi, kena kāraṇena upari bhattaṃ uṇhaṃ, heṭṭhimaṃ sītalan'ti.

examples.text: añño uparimo vaṇṇo, añño vaṇṇo ca heṭṭhimo, brāhmaṇī tv'eva pucchāmi, kiṃ heṭṭhā kiñ'ca uppari.

89027.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of uppari
89027.meaning1: from above; from on top; from overhead

examples.text: diyaḍḍhakukkū udayena kaṇṇikā, vidatthiyo aṭṭha parikkhipanti naṃ, sā siṃsapā sāramayā apheggukā, kuhiṃ ṭhitā upparito na dhaṃsati.
thero c'āmanasikatvā, tuṇhībhūto atikkami, so ca viññāpayī theraṃ, bhātā petagato ahaṃ.

89029.grammar: abs of na vedayati, neg, trans (+acc)
89029.meaning1: having not felt; having not experienced
89029.construction:
na > a + vedaya + itvā
na + vedayitvā

examples.text: ācikkha bhante yadi atthi hetu, saddhāyikaṃ hetuvaco suṇoma, na tesaṃ kammānaṃ vināsam'atthi, avedayitvā idha byantibhāvo'ti.
s'āhaṃ ghorañ'ca sapathaṃ, musāvādañ'ca bhāsisaṃ, n'āhaṃ taṃ aticarāmi, kāyena uda cetasā, kaṇṇamuṇḍo yaṃ sunakho, aṅgam'aṅgāni khādatu.

89031.commentary: (PVa) kisike'ti kisasarīre. pubbe'pi kisā'ti vatvā puna kisike'ti vacanaṃ aṭṭhicammanhārumattasarīratāya ativiya kisabhāvadassan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: naggā dubbaṇṇarūpāsi, kisā dhamanisanthatā, upphāsulike kisike, kā nu tvaṃ idha tiṭṭhasi.
tañ'ca te nhāpayitvāna, vilimpetvāna vāṇijā, vattheh'acchādayitvāna, tassā dakkhiṇam'ādisuṃ.
so taṃ gahetvāna pasayha bāhāyaṃ, pacc'ānayitvāna theriṃ sudubbalaṃ, vajjesi aññam'pi janaṃ idh'āgataṃ, karotha puññāni sukh'ūpalabbhati.

89034.grammar: abs of caus of pa vi √nud, caus, trans (+acc)
89034.meaning1: having dispelled; having driven out; having removed

examples.text: so taṃ vitakkaṃ pavinodayitvā, pītiṃ pasādaṃ paṭiladdhā pacchā, tathāgataṃ jetavane vasantaṃ, yāguyā upaṭṭhāsi sattarattaṃ.

89035.grammar: aor of caus of pati √dis, caus, trans (+acc & +dat)

examples.text: tattha nhatvā pivitvā ca, therassa paṭidassayuṃ, tathā bhante parakkama, yathā yānaṃ labhāmase'ti.

89036.grammar: aor of caus of pati √dis, caus, trans (+acc)
89036.commentary: (JAa) yo me kalyāṇakammānaṃ, pāpānaṃ paṭidassayī'ti yo esa mayhaṃ kalyāṇakammānaṃ devānañ'ca ṭhānāni pāpakammānaṃ nerayikānañ'ca pāpāni ṭhānāni dassesī'ti attho.

examples.text: bah'ūpakāro no bhavaṃ, mātali devasārathi, yo me kalyāṇakammānaṃ, pāpānaṃ paṭidassayi.

89037.commentary: (PVa) uttānā paṭikirāmā'ti kadāci uttānā hutvā vikiriyamān'aṅgapaccaṅgā viya vattāma.

examples.text: chātā pamucchitā bhantā, bhūmiyaṃ paṭisumbhitā, uttānā paṭikirāma, avakujjā patāmase.
soṇṇasopānaphalakā, soṇṇavālukasanthatā, tattha sogandhiyā vaggū, sucigandhā manoramā.
naggā dubbaṇṇarūpā'si, kisā dhamanisanthatā, upphāsulike kisike, kā nu tvaṃ idha tiṭṭhasī'ti.
dujjīvitam'ajīvimha, ye sante na dadamhase, vijjamānesu bhogesu, dīpaṃ n'ākamha attano.

89041.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of dukkha

examples.text: ath'assa dvādasayojanappamāṇo saddo antosālāyam'pi dukkhena suyyittha.

89043.grammar: prp of na krubbati, neg, trans (+acc)
89043.commentary: (SNPa) gāme akubbaṃ muni santhavānī'ti gāme gihisanthavāni akaronto.

examples.text: okaṃ pahāya aniketasārī, gāme akrubbaṃ muni sandhavāni, kāmehi ritto apurakkharāno, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kayirā'ti.

89044.meaning2: fully opened or expanded, full of blossoms

examples.text: vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ, iddhaṃ phītaṃ suphullitaṃ, idha mayhaṃ sakyamunino, sāsanaṃ suvisodhitaṃ.
phalikarajatahemajālachannaṃ, vividhacitratalam'addasaṃ surammaṃ, byamhaṃ sunimmitaṃ toraṇ'ūpapannaṃ, rucak'upakiṇṇam'idaṃ subhaṃ vimānaṃ.

89046.commentary: (VVa) yodhika-bandhuk'anojakā ca santī'ti ca-kāro nipātamattaṃ, yodhika-bandhujīvaka-anojakarukkhā ca santī'ti attho. keci anojakā'pi santī'ti pāṭhaṃ vatvā anojakā'pī'ti vuttaṃ hotī'ti atthaṃ vadanti.

examples.text: padumakumuduppalakuvalayaṃ, yodhika bandhuk'anojakā ca santi, sālakusumitapupphitā asokā, vividhadumaggasugandhasevitamidaṃ.

atīte saṅkhāre taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena n'ābhinandeyya n'ābhivadeyya na ajjhoseyya, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantiṃ kareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyā'ti, purāṇaṃ n'ābhinandeyya.

yo evarūpo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto, paṭighaṃ paṭivirodho, kopo pakopo sampakopo, doso padoso sampadoso, cittassa byāpatti manopadoso, kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ, doso dussanā dussitattaṃ, byāpatti byāpajjanā byāpajjitattaṃ, virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ, asuropo anattamanatā cittassa, ayaṃ vuccati kodho.
yā evarūpā māyā māyāvitā accasarā vañcanā nikati nikiraṇā pariharaṇā gūhanā parigūhanā chādanā paricchādanā anuttānikammaṃ anāvikammaṃ vocchādanā pāpakiriyā, ayaṃ vuccati māyā.
methunadhammassa pahānāya vūpasamāya paṭinissaggāya paṭipassaddhiyā adhisīlam'pi sikkheyya, adhicittam'pi sikkheyya, adhipaññam'pi sikkheyya.

mayañ'c'eva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, n'āss'assa manāpaṃ. yaṃ kho pan'assa amanāpaṃ, kathaṃ naṃ mayaṃ tena samudācareyyāma, sammannati kho pana cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena, yaṃ tumo karissati tumo'va tena paññāyissatī'ti.
purimaṃ sarām'ahaṃ jātiṃ, yattha rajjam'akārayiṃ, kārayitvā tahiṃ rajjaṃ, pāpatthaṃ nirayaṃ bhusaṃ.

89053.meaning1: totally full; full to the brim
89053.construction:
ati > acc + ubbha + aṃ
accubbha + aṃ
89053.commentary: (SaDM) cariyāpiṭakepi hi īdisī saddagati dissati, taṃ yathā? mahādānaṃ pavattesi, accubbhaṃ sāgar'ūpaman'ti. tattha ca accubbhan'ti ativiya yācakānaṃ ajjhāsayaṃ pūraṇaṃ. akkhumbhan'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: akkhobhan'ti abbhantarehi ca bāhirehi ca paccatthikehi appaṭisedhanīyatāya kenaci akkhobhanīyaṃ. accubbhan'ti'pi pāṭho. atipuṇṇadānajjhāsayassa deyyadhammassa ca uḷārabhāvena vipulabhāvena ca ativiya paripuṇṇan'ti attho.

89054.meaning1: taken an opportunity; made the most of it
89054.commentary: (ANa) kat'āvakāsā'ti yena kammena tattha avakāso hoti, tassa katattā kat'āvakāsā. taṃ pana yasmā kusalam'eva hoti, tasmā katakusalā'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kat'āvakāsā katakusalā ito cutā, sayaṃpabhā anuvicaranti nandanaṃ, te tattha nandanti ramanti modare, samappitā kāmaguṇehi pañcahi, katvāna vākyaṃ asitassa tādino, ramanti sagge sugatassa sāvakā'ti.
etāni sutvā nirayāni paṇḍito, aññāni pāpiṭṭhatarāni c'ettha, dhammaṃ care samaṇabrāhmaṇesu, evaṅ'karo saggam'upeti ṭhānaṃ.
pacchimā janatā'ti amhākaṃ ācariyā'pi upajjhāyā'pi evaṃ gāyiṃsū'ti pacchimo jano diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, tath'eva gāyati.
evaṃ raññā āṇattā sārathino asse yojetvā rathe rājadvāre ṭhapetvā rañño ārocesuṃ.

89062.commentary: (JAa) labbhā piyā ocit'atthena pacchā'ti ocit'atthena vaḍḍhit'atthena yasasampannena purisena pacchā piyā nāma sakkā laddhuṃ, na tassā kāraṇā attā nāsetabbo'ti.

examples.text: na ve piyammeti jan'inda tādiso, attaṃ niraṃkatvā piyāni sevati, attā'va seyyo paramā ca seyyo, labbhā piyā ocit'atthena pacchā'ti.

89063.commentary: (VMVt) vimalaketumālā'ti ettha ketumālā nāma sīsato nikkhamitvā uparimuddhani puñjo hutvā dissamāna-rasmirāsī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: tā disvā māṇavo kim'etan'ti ito c'ito ca vilokento addasa bhagavantaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ sant'indriyaṃ dvattiṃsāya mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi asītiyā anubyañjanehi byāmappabhāya ketumālāya ca vijjotamānaṃ anupamāya buddhasiriyā acinteyyena buddh'ānubhāvena virocamānaṃ.

89064.meaning1: light; ray of light; light beam
89064.commentary: (VMVt) vimalaketumālā'ti ettha ketumālā nāma sīsato nikkhamitvā uparimuddhani puñjo hutvā dissamāna-rasmirāsī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: tā disvā māṇavo kim'etan'ti ito c'ito ca vilokento addasa bhagavantaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ sant'indriyaṃ dvattiṃsāya mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi asītiyā anubyañjanehi byāmappabhāya ketumālāya ca vijjotamānaṃ anupamāya buddhasiriyā acinteyyena buddh'ānubhāvena virocamānaṃ.

89065.meaning1: having collected; having piled up; having accumulated

examples.text: ath'ettha catūhi pādehi maṇḍapaṃ katvā tassa upari taṃ gumbaṃ āropesuṃ, so taṃ maṇḍapaṃ chādesi. ath'assa heṭṭhā iṭṭhakāhi paricinitvā vālikaṃ okiritvā āsanaṃ paññāpayiṃsu. sītalaṃ divāṭṭhānaṃ udakavāto vāyati.
ayaṃ pana viseso, samādhinimittan'ti aṭṭhatiṃsāya ārammaṇesu aññataro samādhi'y'eva samādhinimittaṃ.
paṭhamapavāraṇāsikkhāpadaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ pañcamaṃ.
yathā araññanivās'ūpagatā manussā aparicitabhūmibhāgattā udakaṭṭhāna-sañjānan'atthaṃ sākhābhaṅg'ādi-nimittaṃ katvā tadanusārena gantvā udakaṃ paribhuñjanti…

89070.meaning1: name of a country in the lower Indus Valley; modern day Northern Sindh and Southern Punjab

examples.text: magadhesu aṅgesu ca satthavāhā, āropayitvā paṇiyaṃ puthuttaṃ, te yāmase sindhusovīrabhūmiṃ, dhan'atthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā.

89071.commentary: (PVa) vattheh'acchādayitvānā'ti vaṇṇagandharasasampannaṃ sabyañjanaṃ bhojanaṃ bhojetvā nivāsanaṃ uttarīyanti dvīhi vatthehi acchādesuṃ, dve vatthāni adaṃsū'ti attho.

examples.text: tañ'ca te nhāpayitvāna, vilimpetvāna vāṇijā, vattheh'acchādayitvāna, tassā dakkhiṇam'ādisuṃ.

89072.meaningLit: discourse on Upasena and the venomous snake

examples.text: nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu sadutiyavihārī'ti vuccati.

89074.commentary: (VISMa) kiñcanan'ti kiñci'pi. sabhāvadhammassa app'āvasesatā nāma bhaṅgo eva siyā'ti āha bhaṅgamattam'pi assa avasiṭṭhaṃ n'atthī'ti.

examples.text: na hi, atha kho naṃ byantīkaroti vigatantaṃ karoti. yath'āssa anto'pi n'āvasissati antamaso bhaṅgamattam'pi, tathā naṃ karoti.

ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharatī'ti ettha pana n'āssa kiñcanan'ti akiñcanaṃ, antamaso bhaṅgamattam'pi assa avasiṭṭhaṃ n'atthī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. akiñcanassa bhāvo ākiñcaññaṃ, ākās'ānañc'āyatanaviññāṇāpagamassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

89075.commentary: (MNt) bāhir'āyatane'ti titthiyasamaye piṇḍapāto'ti vohāro n'atthi, tasmā sāsanavohārena piṇḍapātappaṭikkanto'ti vuttan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto'ti piṇḍapātato paṭikkanto. sāsane viya kiṃ pana bāhir'āyatane piṇḍapāto'ti vohāro atthī'ti, n'atthi.
iti ajjhattaṃ vā'ti evaṃ ajjhattik'āyatana-pariggahaṇena attano vā dhammesu, bāhir'āyatana-pariggahaṇena parassa vā dhammesu, kālena vā attano, kālena vā parassa dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati.

89077.commentary: (SNa) upassutī'ti upassutiṭṭhānaṃ, yaṃ ṭhānaṃ upagatena sakkā hoti bhagavato saddaṃ sotuṃ, tattha ṭhito'ti attho. so kira gandhakuṭi-pariveṇa-sammajjan'atthaṃ āgato attano kammaṃ pahāya bhagavato dhammaghosaṃ suṇanto aṭṭhāsi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu bhagavato upassuti ṭhito hoti. addasā kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upassuti ṭhitaṃ. disvāna taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca, assosi no tvaṃ, bhikkhu, imaṃ dhammapariyāyan'ti?
evam'etasmiṃ sattamasutte ca arahattaṃ kathitan'ti.

89079.meaning1: goes by the term; falls in the category of; is included in

examples.text: yadapi, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ dhammesu vicikicchā tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ, yadapi bahiddhā dhammesu vicikicchā tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ. vicikicchānīvaraṇan'ti iti h'idaṃ uddesaṃ gacchati. tadaminā'p'etaṃ pariyāyena dvayaṃ hoti.

89082.construction:
silā > selā + eyya + ka
seleyya + ka

examples.text: pāsāṇajāti-pāsāṇadaddu-sevāla-seleyyak'ādīni aharitavaṇṇāni apattakāni ca dukkaṭavatthukāni. ahicchattakaṃ yāva makuḷaṃ hoti, tāva dukkaṭavatthu.

89083.meaning1: and they sustain it for a long time; they maintain it for life

examples.text: ayaṃ kho, mahārāja, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo yen'ime daharā bhikkhū susū kāḷakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañ'ca āpādentī'ti.

ayaṃ kho, mahārāja, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo yen'ime daharā bhikkhū susū kāḷakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañ'ca āpādentī'ti.

sace pana agacchante yāne vā hatthipiṭṭhiy'ādīsu vā ṭhapetvā abhiruhitvā sāreti, heṭṭhā vā gacchanto codeti, pakkosanto vā anubandhāpeti, aññaṃ harāpetī'ti vacanato anāpatti. kurundiy'ādīsu pana āpattī'ti vuttaṃ, taṃ aññaṃ harāpetī'ti iminā na sameti.

ayaṃ kho, mahārāja, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo yen'ime daharā bhikkhū susū kāḷakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañ'ca āpādentī'ti.
sukhaṃ diṭṭham'ariyebhi, sakkāyassa nirodhanaṃ, paccanīkam'idaṃ hoti, sabbalokena passataṃ.
devadaho khaṇo rūpā, dve natumhākam'eva ca, hetunā'pi tayo vuttā, duve ajjhattabāhirā'ti.

89091.commentary: (UDa) purāṇakammavipākajan'ti pubbe katassa kammassa vipākabhāvena jātaṃ, purāṇakammavipāke vā sukhadukkhappakāre vipākavaṭṭasamudāye tadekadesabhāvena jātaṃ. kiṃ taṃ? dukkhaṃ. purāṇakammavipākajan'ti ca iminā tassa ābādhassa kammasamuṭṭhānataṃ dassento opakkamika-utu-vipariṇāmaj'ādi-bhāvaṃ paṭikkhipati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya purāṇakammavipākajaṃ dukkhaṃ tibbaṃ kharaṃ kaṭukaṃ vedanaṃ adhivāsento sato sampajāno avihaññamāno.

idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojaniyā. ty'āssa anto vasanti, ant'assa vasanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā'ti. tasmā santevāsiko'ti vuccati.

89093.meaning1: for the fading of desire; for the disappearance of lust; for the sake of dispassion

examples.text: sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, rāgavirāg'atthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi. rāgavirāg'attho hi, bhikkhu, mayā dhammo desito.
evam'eva nūn'amhe'pi, issare bahukaṇṭake, amittā no vadhissanti, yathā ambo phalī hato.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khīrarukkho assattho vā nigrodho vā pilakkho vā udumbaro vā sukkho kolāpo terovassiko. tam'enaṃ puriso tiṇhāya kuṭhāriyā yato yato ābhindeyya āgaccheyya khīran'ti?

89096.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of pacchā
89096.meaning1: to the west; in a westerly direction

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso bahukaṇṭakaṃ dāyaṃ paviseyya. tassa purato'pi kaṇṭako, pacchato'pi kaṇṭako, uttarato'pi kaṇṭako, dakkhiṇato'pi kaṇṭako, heṭṭhato'pi kaṇṭako, uparito'pi kaṇṭako. so sato'va abhikkameyya, sato'va paṭikkameyya, mā maṃ kaṇṭako'ti.

89098.meaning1: there is, Ānanda; there are, Ānanda

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? atth'ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañ'ca paṇītatarañ'ca.

sīlabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca ñātibalena, vāsent'eva naṃ, kule na nāsenti. sīlabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca puttabalena, vāsent'eva naṃ, kule na nāsenti. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balānī'ti.

tassa evaṃ hoti, sace kho maṃ bhikkhū jānissanti, dussīlo pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujātoti, samaggā maṃ santā nāsessanti, vaggā pana maṃ na nāsessantī'ti.
